advisoryFindings.summary: Wallet credit commits independently before return state transition is durable — race condition can produce credited-but-rejected return
advisoryFindings.details: processVendorConfirmation calls walletMutationDelegate.doReturnCreditInTx(...) in a REQUIRES_NEW transaction, then saves RETURN_CONFIRMED in the outer transaction. If the outer transaction rolls back (e.g., due to an OptimisticLockException from a concurrent vendor rejection webhook or admin resolve), the wallet credit is already committed but the return status is not RETURN_CONFIRMED. The user ends up with a credited wallet on a rejected return.
advisoryFindings.recommendation: Serialize terminal return transitions with a pessimistic lock (e.g., findByIdWithLock) before committing wallet credit. Prefer one atomic transaction for state+ledger, or use an outbox/state-machine step pattern where the wallet credit is only enqueued (not committed) until the return state is durable.
advisoryFindings.softStagePromotion: adversarial-review in --soft-stages: blocking tier demoted to advisory
advisoryFindings.actionRequired: manual — requires architectural decision on pessimistic locking or outbox pattern

advisoryFindings.summary: RestTemplate constructed inline without timeouts — stalled vendor API can exhaust async executor
advisoryFindings.details: ReturnVendorService constructs new RestTemplate() inline on every call path. With no connect/read timeout configured, a stalled Xoxoday endpoint will block the async thread indefinitely. The retry/DLQ path only activates on exception — so a blackholed connection never reaches it.
advisoryFindings.recommendation: Inject a configured RestTemplate or RestClient bean with bounded connect/read/response timeouts. Make timeout values configurable via application.yml.
advisoryFindings.actionRequired: manual — inject RestTemplate bean with timeout configuration

advisoryFindings.summary: @Audited(COMPLETED) fires for both confirm and reject paths in webhook handler
advisoryFindings.details: The @Audited(action = 'COMPLETED') annotation on handleReturnWebhook fires for every invocation, including when payload.confirmed() == false. This causes the audit log to record COMPLETED for returns that are being rejected by the vendor.
advisoryFindings.recommendation: Remove @Audited from the controller method and emit a programmatic audit event inside ReturnService.processVendorConfirmation(), branching on the confirmed flag.
advisoryFindings.actionRequired: manual — requires programmatic audit call in service layer

advisoryFindings.summary: @Audited(COMPLETED) hardcoded on resolveTimedOutReturn — REJECT resolution emits incorrect audit action
advisoryFindings.details: The @Audited(action = 'COMPLETED') annotation on the resolveTimedOutReturn endpoint fires regardless of whether the admin chose CONFIRM or REJECT as the resolution. A reject resolution produces a COMPLETED audit entry, which is incorrect.
advisoryFindings.recommendation: Remove @Audited from the controller method and emit a programmatic audit event inside ReturnService.resolveTimedOut(), branching on the resolution enum.
advisoryFindings.actionRequired: manual — requires programmatic audit call in service layer

advisoryFindings.summary: No startup guard for blank xoxoday signing secret — app starts silently and rejects all webhooks
advisoryFindings.details: If redemption.return-webhook.xoxoday.signing-secret is not set in the environment, xoxodaySigningSecret defaults to '' (empty string). The app starts without error but silently rejects every Xoxoday webhook with 403. Per PROJECT-CONTEXT.md, webhook signing secrets must be validated non-blank at startup via @PostConstruct.
advisoryFindings.recommendation: Add a @PostConstruct method (or @Configuration @Bean guard) that throws IllegalStateException if xoxodaySigningSecret is blank in non-test profiles.

advisoryFindings.summary: @Profile silently ignored on @PostConstruct validateConfig in ReturnVendorService
advisoryFindings.details: Spring's @Profile annotation is not supported on individual @PostConstruct methods within a @Service class — it is only honoured on @Bean and @Configuration class declarations. As a result, validateConfig() runs in ALL profiles, including test and localtest, despite the annotation.
advisoryFindings.recommendation: Extract the @PostConstruct validation to a @Configuration class (or a @Bean method guarded by @Profile), or add a programmatic profile check inside the method: if (env.acceptsProfiles(Profiles.of('!test', '!localtest'))) { ... }
advisoryFindings.actionRequired: manual — Spring limitation, needs @Configuration extraction or programmatic profile check

advisoryFindings.summary: Kafka events published inside @Transactional before commit in processVendorConfirmation
advisoryFindings.details: returnEventProducer.publishReturnConfirmed(ret) is called inside the @Transactional processVendorConfirmation before the transaction commits. approveReturn() correctly uses TransactionSynchronizationManager.afterCommit() for event publishing. This inconsistency means that if the DB commit fails after Kafka publish in processVendorConfirmation, consumers receive a RETURN_CONFIRMED event for a return that was never saved as confirmed.
advisoryFindings.recommendation: Wrap the publishReturnConfirmed call in TransactionSynchronizationManager.afterCommit(() -> returnEventProducer.publishReturnConfirmed(ret)) to match the pattern used in approveReturn().

advisoryFindings.summary: Silent wallet-credit miss when original redemption not found in processVendorConfirmation
advisoryFindings.details: When the originalRedemption lookup returns empty in processVendorConfirmation, the code logs a warning but then continues to transition the return to RETURN_CONFIRMED with no wallet credit issued. The caller receives a RETURN_CONFIRMED audit event but no funds were returned to the user.
advisoryFindings.recommendation: On missing originalRedemption, either throw a recoverable exception (to trigger retry), transition to a RETURN_ERROR state, or at minimum log at ERROR level with a PagerDuty-triggerable alert key.
advisoryFindings.actionRequired: manual — requires a decision on error state vs retry strategy
